entities.summary: Frank James Sensenbrenner Jr. is an American politician who represented Wisconsin's 5th congressional district in the United States House of Representatives from 1979 to 2021. He is a member of the Republican Party. Jim Sensenbrenner was a legal figures from Chicago (b. 1943-06-14, Chicago). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
